title: Library-comparison verdicts of one chart type (ARC-64, FEA-CH-75)

type.description: RichView chart type, as in comparison.json

reviewer.description: The model that judged, as named by the platform

comparedAgainst.description: Exactly the libraries comparison.json lists for the type

verdict.description: The overall verdict: the lowest verdict any reference-by-criterion cell earns at either width in any RichView style, unless a reason explains a higher one

byStyle.description: Overall verdict per RichView style (for example sleek, air); optional, absent in verdicts written before the Air capture

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what decides the verdict

fixes.description: Concrete RichView changes that would raise the verdict; empty when it withstands

notComparable.description: Differences the lab cannot judge fairly (reference configuration, missing mapping, library limits)

reasons.description: Observations from the captures, each naming the width (720 or 390) and the reference it compares with

byStyle.description: Verdict per RichView style when the styles differ; optional
